author: Antonialock
body: Thanks Val. Pombe used to have EXP annotations to poly(A) RNA polymerase activity (based on weak in virtro activity) which I removed in July. However, "the current uniprot release was trained using 2026_03, which was built around June 2026" (according to the developers) which is why it is still present. It should be gone next release, will check back.
